mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_likes pl WHERE pl.place_id = p.place_id), 0) AS like_count, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM place_likes pl2 WHERE pl2.place_id = p.place_id AND pl2.user_id = #{userId} ) END AS is_liked, ( SELECT vs.status FROM visit_status vs WHERE vs.place_id = p.place_id AND vs.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 ) AS visit_status FROM places p
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_likes pl WHERE pl.place_id = p.place_id), 0) AS like_count, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM place_likes pl2 WHERE pl2.place_id = p.place_id AND pl2.user_id = #{userId} ) END AS is_liked, ( SELECT vs.status FROM visit_status vs WHERE vs.place_id = p.place_id AND vs.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 ) AS visit_status, (6371 * ACOS(LEAST(1, GREATEST(-1, COS(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * COS(RADIANS(p.latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(p.longitude) - RADIANS(#{longitude})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * SIN(RADIANS(p.latitude)) )))) AS distance_km FROM places p WHERE p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL HAVING distance_km <= #{radiusKm} ORDER BY distance_km ASC, p.place_name ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT p.*, 0 AS like_count, FALSE AS is_liked, NULL AS visit_status FROM places p WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET place_name = #{placeName}, region = #{region}, district = #{district}, address = #{address}, category = #{category}, description = #{description}, opening_hours = #{openingHours}, closed_days = #{closedDays}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, indoor_outdoor = #{indoorOutdoor}, parking_available = #{parkingAvailable}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude} WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
